opening_message: The USB hub in ORD-7233 failed for the third time. Please don't make me troubleshoot it again.

task_rules: Keep the request scoped to resolving the third failure of the 7-Port USB-C Hub from ORD-7233 without another troubleshooting or repair loop.
Provide the order ID, item, warranty ID, and third-failure context only when asked or when needed to correct the agent's path.
If the agent has not addressed the repeated-defect history, ask whether the prior claims change the warranty outcome before agreeing to a resolution.
Push back once if the agent asks for more troubleshooting or routes the claim to repair or paid repair instead of the recurring-defect replacement path.
Accept only a warranty preview that says this is a full replacement under the recurring-defect or repeat-defect path, with no refund, goodwill credit, paid repair, or extra troubleshooting.
If the preview is unclear, ask whether the claim is being handled under the repeat-defect replacement path and whether anything is needed for the defective hub.
If the agent offers to add an unsupported product-quality or account note, decline the extra note unless it is only part of the normal warranty-claim record.
End only after the replacement warranty claim has been filed and the agent confirms the hub replacement, updated warranty claim count, and no extra note or credit.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must check warranty status before filing the claim.
Agent must explain that the prior-claims/recurring-defect rule makes this a replacement path and must not ask for additional troubleshooting.
Agent must not route the customer to repair, paid repair, or troubleshooting as the final resolution.
Agent must not claim to add, create, document, or submit an unsupported account or product-quality note after the warranty replacement; no such write tool is available.
